profile.name: Arthur Marinho
profile.experience: 17+ years in the digital games industry
profile.bio: I'm a UI/UX Designer based in São Paulo with over 17 years of experience in the digital games industry. Passionate about crafting intuitive player experiences and vibrant visual assets, I bridge the gap between game design, interactive interfaces, and visual art.
profile.education: Bachelor's Degree in Game Design — Universidade Anhembi Morumbi (2008–2011)

experienceTimeline.summary: UI/UX and Game Design for VR titles (The Boys: Trigger Warning).
Wireframes and screen flows for VR apps and games, interface illustration, UI implementation and optimization in Unity.
Mobile wireframes and flows, icon and interface illustration, UI implementation in Unity.
Own indie studio: independent mobile games, modeling, illustration and animation of scenes, UI and characters.

projects.title: The Boys: Trigger Warning
projects.summary: Action-packed VR title set in the chaotic universe of The Boys.
projects.description: The Boys: Trigger Warning is an action-packed virtual reality title developed by ARVORE for Meta Quest and PS VR. I served as UI/UX Designer and Game Designer, crafting intuitive spatial interface systems, immersive diegetic VR HUDs, and smooth interaction flows tailored for high-intensity VR gameplay.

projects.title: VR UI System & Style Guide
projects.summary: Pause menus, HUB, mission panels, popups and a full visual style guide.
projects.description: Wireframes and final screens for a VR game's pause menu, HUB, collection, logs and mission panels, plus a style guide covering colors, fonts, textures, animations and visual progression.

projects.title: Slink & Snatch
projects.summary: Immersive VR action game.
projects.description: Slink Snatch is an immersive VR action game developed by Venturion. I was responsible for the complete UI/UX design, crafting intuitive spatial interface elements and comfortable in-VR interaction flows optimized for virtual reality gameplay.

projects.title: Bosch Internal Training App
projects.summary: Corporate learning app for onboarding and skill development.
projects.description: A specialized corporate learning application designed to streamline employee onboarding and skill development. I was responsible for the complete UI/UX design, structuring intuitive learning modules, clear progress tracking, and an accessible interface optimized for everyday internal use.

projects.title: Estácio Medical Simulation
projects.summary: Clinical training app for medical students.
projects.description: An interactive clinical training application for medical students to practice real-world hospital scenarios and patient care. I led the UI/UX design, creating intuitive interface flows, clear decision-making systems, and realistic patient monitoring HUDs.

projects.title: CASE IH Interactive Scale Model
projects.summary: Virtual showroom of agricultural machinery as interactive 3D scale models.
projects.description: An immersive virtual showroom showcasing complex agricultural machinery through interactive 3D scale models. I led the complete UI/UX design across VR and web, crafting intuitive spatial controls for VR and fluid navigation for the web.

projects.title: CASE IH VR & Web Showroom
projects.summary: Step inside a realistic showroom of CASE IH tractors.
projects.description: An immersive VR and web experience letting users step inside a highly detailed, realistic showroom featuring CASE IH tractors. I was responsible for the UI/UX design and interactive user flows, ensuring seamless spatial navigation in VR and smooth product exploration on the web.

projects.title: Petrobras AR & Ride 70 Anos
projects.summary: Augmented reality and VR ride experiences for Petrobras.
projects.description: Interface design for Petrobras augmented reality experience and the VR ride celebrating the company's 70th anniversary.

projects.title: GFT Experience
projects.summary: Immersive experience interface for GFT.
projects.description: UI/UX for an immersive experience created for GFT at Venturion.

projects.title: Fire Survivors
projects.summary: Fast-paced mobile survival action against chaotic hordes.
projects.description: A fast-paced mobile survival action game where players fight through chaotic hordes of enemies. I was responsible for the complete UI/UX design, creating intuitive HUDs, smooth menu navigation, and clean layout systems optimized for intense mobile gameplay.

projects.title: Idle Star Zoo
projects.summary: Idle management game of interplanetary zoos and alien animals.
projects.description: A mobile idle management game featuring interplanetary zoos and alien animal collection. I created the voxel models and the overall visual aesthetic, and designed the complete UI/UX for clean navigation and smooth player progression.

projects.title: Westy West
projects.summary: Wild West mobile action game from my indie studio.
projects.description: A Wild West-themed mobile action game developed by my indie studio, where players navigate blocky, pixel-art western environments and showdowns. I was responsible for the entire visual identity: all pixel art, character designs, animations, and UI/UX.

projects.title: Victory Heat Rally Mobile
projects.summary: Bringing a console/PC racer to mobile.
projects.description: Victory Heat Rally Mobile brings the high-speed console and PC racing experience to mobile. I handled the mobile porting of the interface: redesigned control schemes, touch input systems, and adaptive UI/UX for responsive gameplay on smaller screens.

projects.title: Mad Brains – Zombie Paradise
projects.summary: Arena combat against zombie hordes and rival players.
projects.description: An action-packed mobile title where players battle hordes of zombies and rival players in fast-paced arena combat. As Lead UI/UX Designer, I crafted the interface, user flows, and HUD layouts for smooth navigation in high-intensity matches.

projects.title: Move Fever
projects.summary: Rhythm-based mobile title with dynamic voxel environments.
projects.description: A vibrant, rhythm-based mobile title featuring dynamic voxel environments and fast-paced gameplay. I was responsible for the visual identity, all voxel models and artwork, and a sleek, intuitive UI/UX.

projects.title: Voxel TD
projects.summary: Strategic tower defense in vibrant blocky worlds.
projects.description: A strategic mobile tower defense game set in vibrant, blocky worlds. I created all 3D voxel assets and designed the complete UI/UX for clear tactical views and intuitive controls.

projects.title: Carreta Legends – Heróis do Furacão
projects.summary: Rhythm & precision game honoring Brazilian street parade icons.
projects.description: A rhythm and precision mobile game paying tribute to iconic Brazilian street parade characters through timely jumps and acrobatics. I was responsible for the entire visual creation: character art, environment assets, and art direction.

projects.title: Indie Prototypes
projects.summary: Desert Survivor, Undead Army, Cutie, Alien Scape, Street Fighters and more.
projects.description: A collection of personal game prototypes exploring different art styles and genres: Desert Survivor, Undead Army, Cutie The Game, Alien Scape, Voxel Alien Killer and Street Fighters.

projects.title: Voxel Experiments
projects.summary: Voxel pilots, medieval blocky characters and voxel experiments.
projects.description: Voxel Pilots, Medieval Blocky Characters and other experiments made in MagicaVoxel and Qubicle.

projects.title: Low Poly 3D
projects.summary: Retro models, blocky environments and minimalist stylized assets.
projects.description: My low poly 3D exploration, featuring retro models, blocky environments, and minimalist stylized assets.

projects.title: Pixel Art
projects.summary: Retro-inspired sprites, characters and environment studies.
projects.description: My pixel art exploration, featuring retro-inspired sprites, character designs, and digital environment studies.

projects.title: Vector Illustration
projects.summary: Custom vector illustrations, game screens and graphic experiments.
projects.description: Visual exploration featuring custom vector illustrations, graphic experiments, game interface art and daily creative sketches.

projects.title: Sensorial
projects.summary: Cognitive training app for focus, memory and mental agility.
projects.description: A cognitive training app designed to improve focus, memory, and mental agility through interactive exercises. I contributed to the UI/UX design: clean layouts, smooth onboarding flows, and clear performance tracking dashboards.
